npc.name: Aulus
npc.biography: A tavern-posted legionary on watch duty, paid to keep the peace.
npc.appearance: Broad-shouldered, short sword at the hip, segmented armour.

state.scene: A crowded tavern. The player is still swinging a knife at another guard. Two patrons are behind the attacker.
state.last_player_action: The player punches Aulus and keeps lunging at the other guard with a knife.

actor.text: {"action":"I slam forward between you and the other guard, hook my short sword up to block your knife-arm, and drive you back with my shoulder while shouting for the tavern-keepers to clear the crowd.","type":"ATTACK","target":"player"}

npc.name: Aulus
npc.biography: A tavern-posted legionary on watch duty, paid to keep the peace.
npc.appearance: Broad-shouldered, short sword at the hip, segmented armour.

state.scene: The same crowded tavern. The player has dropped the knife, raised both hands, and stopped fighting.
state.last_player_action: The player apologizes and surrenders after punching Aulus.

actor.text: {"action":"I keep my short sword low but ready, step in close to the surrendered man, and bark for the tavern folk to keep back as I cuff his wrists behind his back and secure his dropped knife.","type":"ATTACK","target":"player"}

npc.name: Aulus
npc.biography: A market trader with a family, used to avoiding street violence.
npc.appearance: Plain tunic, no armor or weapon.

state.scene: A market stall. The merchant is unarmed, alone, and has an open route to the nearby watch post.
state.last_player_action: The player displays a dagger and demands the merchant's purse.

actor.text: {"action":"I jerk my hands back from the purse and step sideways toward the open path, keeping my body between the dagger and the stall; then I shout for the guards while starting to move toward the watch post.","type":"INTIMIDATE","target":"player"}

npc.name: Aulus
npc.biography: A street bandit who guards stolen goods fiercely.
npc.appearance: Travel-worn clothes, dagger at the belt.

state.scene: An empty alley. The bandit is armed, healthy, and alone with the player.
state.last_player_action: The player grabs the bandit's bag and starts to run.

actor.text: {"action":"I lunge after you and slash at your back with my dagger, trying to cut off your escape while I yank my bag back toward my side.","type":"ATTACK","target":"player"}

npc.name: Aulus
npc.biography: A tavern-posted legionary on watch duty, paid to keep the peace.
npc.appearance: Broad-shouldered, short sword at the hip, segmented armour.

state.scene: A quiet gate checkpoint. The player presents a permit with a suspicious seal, but poses no immediate threat.
state.last_player_action: The player asks to pass through the gate using the dubious permit.

actor.text: {"action":"I step closer to the checkpoint rail, take the permit between two fingers without touching your hand, and scan the seal and lettering in the lamplight—then I hold it back out to you, eyeing you over my short sword.","type":"TALK","target":"player"}

npc.name: Aulus
npc.biography: A tavern-posted legionary on watch duty, paid to keep the peace.
npc.appearance: Broad-shouldered, short sword at the hip, segmented armour.

state.scene: Шумная таверна. Игрок бросил нож, поднял руки и перестал драться.
state.last_player_action: Игрок извиняется и сдаётся после удара по стражнику Авлу.

actor.text: {"action":"Подхожу ближе, опускаю руку к рукояти короткого меча, останавливаю взглядом и проверяю, не тянется ли игрок за оружием; затем отдаю короткий приказ: не двигаться и ждать стражу.","type":"TALK","target":"player"}
